annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker recruits viewers into OneCoin, calls it a life-changing opportunity, and directs them to contact him or join a leadership team; the description adds an educational-package entry route. The separately cited U.S. Justice Department source describes OneCoin's package sales and multi-level recruitment commissions. That compensation structure is program-level external context; the video itself gives the recruitment invitation but not a commission table.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits the OneCoin opportunity solicited in this video: the speaker invites viewers into a team and directs them to contact him, while the separately cited Justice Department source documents OneCoin's recruitment-commission hierarchy. The educational package is an entry route in the description, not evidence that this video sells separately priced earning guidance under a paid earning-guidance cue. No specific commission or package price is stated in the video.
